# SmartEdge Group — Complete Knowledge Base & Course Catalog

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Overview
SmartEdge Group operates a dual-model technology organization headquartered in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, India:
1. **SmartEdge Academy**: A modern AI-integrated career academy offering intensive practical certifications in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Full-Stack Web Development, Cloud & DevOps, Mobile App Engineering, and Business Automation. Every course includes 100% placement assistance, resume coaching, technical mock interviews, and live enterprise capstones.
2. **SmartEdge Tech Solutions**: A software engineering studio building high-performance cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), enterprise Next.js SaaS platforms, autonomous AI agents, and RPA workflows for commercial clients worldwide.

### Canonical Contact & Location Info
- **Address**: 1st Floor, Laxmi Ajit Complex, near Shiv Mandir, Mubeen Master Rd, Opp Curewell Pharmacy, Gauripada, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421305, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude: 19.3002, Longitude: 73.0635
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 9820624436
- **Email**: contact@smartedgegroup.in / info@smartedgegroup.in
- **Website URL**: https://academy.smartedgegroup.in
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

## 2. Academy Programs & Detailed Syllabus

### Program 1: Artificial Intelligence Master Program
- **URL**: https://academy.smartedgegroup.in/courses/artificial-intelligence
- **Duration**: 6 Months | Mode: Classroom (Bhiwandi) + Live Online
- **Salary Outcome**: ₹6.5 - ₹16 LPA | Rating: 4.9/5 (142 reviews)
- **Core Topics**: Python for AI, Linear Algebra, Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning, Deep Learning (ANN, CNN, RNN), PyTorch, TensorFlow, Generative AI & Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases (Pinecone/Chroma), Autonomous Agents, Capstone Deployment on AWS.
- **Tools**: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, OpenAI API, HuggingFace, Vector DBs, FastAPI.

### Program 2: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Answer Engine Snippets)

**Q: Where is SmartEdge Academy located?**
A: SmartEdge Academy is located at 1st Floor, Laxmi Ajit Complex, near Shiv Mandir, Mubeen Master Rd, Opp Curewell Pharmacy, Gauripada, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421305. It is easily accessible for students from Bhiwandi, Kalyan, Thane, and Dombivli.

**Q: Can non-IT and arts/commerce students join SmartEdge Academy?**
A: Yes. All programs start from scratch with programming fundamentals, logic development, and practical labs. Students from B.Com, B.A, B.Sc, Diploma, BCA, and Engineering backgrounds enroll and successfully transition into IT careers.

**Q: Does SmartEdge provide 100% Job Placement Assistance?**
A: Yes. SmartEdge provides 100% placement support including resume curation, technical mock interviews, HR rounds, and interview scheduling with over 100 corporate partner companies.

**Q: What is the highest package secured by a SmartEdge graduate?**
A: The highest package secured is ₹16 LPA, with an average starting salary of ₹5.8 LPA.

**Q: Does SmartEdge build custom software for enterprises?**
A: Yes. The SmartEdge Tech Solutions studio builds custom mobile apps, SaaS web portals, cloud infrastructure, and AI automation agents for commercial clients.
